name: jellyfin-watchback
description: Personal annual Jellyfin playback rewinds with measured activity, conservative reconstruction, localized charts and seasonal visibility.
overview: Your personal annual Jellyfin playback rewind.

versions.changelog:
v1.0.1.0 - Annual rewind corrections

- The rewind follows the signed-in user's language, serves frozen reports straight from storage, shows scalable genre info icons, hides an empty music streak and counts imported Playback Reporting durations as recorded data.
- Verified by 93% backend unit test coverage, 97% UI test coverage, and 11 end-to-end Docker tests
- Requires Jellyfin 12.4
Initial Watchback version with personal annual rewinds and continuous activity recording.
